Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and presence of Proteus mirabilis >100,000 CFU/mL, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are also present. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
